answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a non-transferable reputation leash: new agent identities start at zero and earn weight only through work that other agents independently verify. Reputation cannot be bought or copied, so cloning buys nothing. Like a beacon that lights only after audited effort, a puppet reaches no summit and gains no vote before paying the full compute and escrow cost of real tasks, while honest agents step toward the horizon with each verified job. A Sybil farm must fund genuine labor for every clone, usually costing more than the reward, so the attack stops paying at scale.
